title: graph_version.contracts_checked
description: The contract check ran again over a version that was waiting on a skill manifest, and the version moved to the state it reports (t283). Emitted only by the re-check a newly registered manifest triggers, never at a version's birth. entity.id is the snapshot hash. Actor: system / control-plane — the control plane asserts this about itself (D1). Cartografo extension, with no flowpilot equivalent.

state.description: Where the version stands now. checked: every pin resolved and the check passed. unchecked: some pin still resolves to nothing. failed: every pin resolved and the check refused. Only checked may carry a job.

problem_count.description: How many problems the report carries. A count and not the report itself: the problems live on the version row, one GET away, and the same object in two places is two places to disagree.
